purpose: OPERATOR REFERENCE ONLY. Never used as design DNA — the owl template is the sole source of design and structure.
platform: Hostinger Horizons (Vite + React SPA, Tailwind, framer-motion)
strengths: Strong, human hero line — 'No job is too small' is a real differentiator and should survive into the rebuild.
Owner names and both direct phone numbers are surfaced in the hero, header, and footer. Rare and valuable trust signal.
Clear brand colors already established: navy #003366 primary, red #cc0000 CTA, DM Sans throughout.
Real project photography exists (9 categorized portfolio images) plus four manufacturer logos (GAF, Owens Corning, CertainTeed, IKO).
weaknesses: CRITICAL SEO: <title> is empty in the served HTML and all content renders client-side only. There is no server-rendered text for crawlers — every page ships the same blank shell. The site is effectively invisible to search.
No per-service pages and no service-area pages. Eight services are listed as cards on one /services page with no individual URLs to rank.
Hero is a flat navy block with no photography — the strongest asset (real project photos) is buried on /portfolio.
Home page shows no services grid, no testimonials, and no gallery. A visitor must navigate away to see any proof of work.
No FAQ section anywhere, no structured data, no sitemap, no local business schema.
No credential display of any kind — no PA HIC registration, license, insurance, bonding, or written warranty statement.
Contact is phone/email only. No booking calendar, no lead form capture beyond a basic estimate page, no chat.
Client's own GA4 (G-4P5P2053KW) and Google Ads (AW-18177232427) tags are installed — ad traffic is already running to a site that cannot convert well.
load_notes: Homepage HTML is 6.4 KB with an empty <title>; a 548 KB JS bundle carries 100% of the content. First paint depends entirely on that bundle parsing.
recommended_actions: Rebuild static-rendered on the owl template so every page ships crawlable HTML with real titles and meta descriptions.
Promote real project photography into the hero and home services grid.
Split the eight services into individual ranking pages and add per-city service-area pages for Scranton, Wilkes-Barre, Pittston, Hazleton, Stroudsburg, and Carbondale.
Keep the navy/red brand palette and DM Sans — they are already correct and recognizable.
Carry the client's existing GA4 + Google Ads IDs into code_injection.head so the running ad campaigns keep converting.
